items.title: EPC Document Review Is Not a Search Problem
items.summary: In the seven weeks before this was published, Trimble bought Document Crunch and Trunk Tools shipped its Autodesk Forma integration. The AI-for-construction-submittals category, in the commercial sense, is now claimed. The EPC technical review surface — vendor documents against NACE, API, ASME, and a project specification — is a different shape, and it is still mostly unaddressed.

items.title: Inside the Fence: The Document Review Bottleneck in Data Center Delivery
items.summary: Power and transformers will get sorted by the utilities and OEMs. Of the things owners can actually control in the last 90 days of a data center build, document review is increasingly the biggest one — and at $14M a day in delay cost, it is worth taking seriously.

items.title: The Most Important AI Object in Construction Is the Disposition Code
items.summary: A — Approved. B — Approved with Comments. C — Revise and Resubmit. D — Rejected. Four codes, codified in Oracle Primavera and every major EPC contractor's workflow, that decide whether a project moves. Most AI tools treat them as a sentence at the end of an answer. They are not.

items.title: Handover is not a binder. It is the evidence layer for operations.
items.summary: Aconex's own Smart Manual documentation says it directly: the quality of the handover manual depends on the quality of the asset information in the underlying document and asset register. For a hyperscale data center, that register is what facilities inherits — and what AI review can actually help complete.

items.title: What we learned building document agents
items.summary: 2025 brought us the new idiom for building AI: give it tools to operate a computer. Capability is no longer the hard part — the translation layer between the agent's workspace and the user's files of record is. Here's what we learned building that layer.

items.title: Beating Frontier Models on OfficeQA Pro at 10x Lower Cost
items.summary: OfficeQA Pro scores agents on grounded Treasury Bulletin QA. We held the public Databricks parse fixed and pushed Gemini 3 Flash to the strongest accuracy we are aware of on that suite—at a fraction of the cost—with retrieval, anchoring, and harness discipline above the parse.

items.title: The Illusion of the Correct Answer: Why High-Stakes Work Demands Document Engineering
items.summary: Every week a new model tops the leaderboards, yet they still fail at complex knowledge work. Here is why the illusion of Pass@1 is holding agents back, and why reliability requires a version-controlled architecture of trust.

items.title: AI Agents for CMC: Streamlining Tech Transfer to Regulatory Submissions
items.summary: Discover how AI agents are transforming CMC workflows from tech transfer documentation to regulatory submissions. Learn about the future of document intelligence in pharmaceutical manufacturing.
